title: It happened... and it changed everything
objective: Relater une expérience et ses conséquences

steps.title: Warm-up: a memorable day
steps.student_instruction: Think of a memorable day. Tell a partner where you were and what happened, in two sentences.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Faire émerger des récits courts ; noter les formes passées produites.

steps.title: Listening: Difficult situations
steps.student_instruction: Listen to three difficult situations. For each one, note what happened and the consequences.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Faire écouter l'audio British Council (QR code) ; sans réseau, lire le script de secours. Grille événement / conséquence / réaction ; aborder les situations avec tact (perte d'un animal).

steps.title: Language focus: past simple and past continuous
steps.student_instruction: Contrast background actions (was walking) and events (saw). Link with so, as a result, since then.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Frise temporelle au tableau ; while + past continuous, when + past simple.

steps.title: Differentiated practice
steps.student_instruction: Complete your A, B or C sheet.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A : formes à compléter ; B : récit à partir d'une trame ; C : récit avec conséquences et leçon tirée.

steps.title: Storytelling circle
steps.student_instruction: Tell your group about an experience (real or imagined) in one to two minutes. Listeners ask one follow-up question.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Groupes de 4 ; laisser le choix d'un récit inventé pour préserver l'intimité ; observer la cohérence chronologique et causale.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write one sentence with while and one with as a result.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Ramasser ; vérifier past continuous / past simple.

sheets.student_content: Complete: I ___ (walk) to school when I ___ (see) an accident. While we ___ (wait), it ___ (start) to rain. I missed the bus, ___ I was late.
sheets.facilitator_correction: was walking / saw ; were waiting / started ; so.

sheets.student_content: Write a 100-word story using this plan: background (was / were + -ing), the event, two consequences, how you felt.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Exemple : Last year I was walking to school when an old man fell. I called for help. As a result, the ambulance came quickly. Since then, I have taken a first-aid course.

sheets.student_content: Write a 150-word story about an experience that changed you (a trip, a move, a problem). Include consequences and what you learnt.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production libre ; critères : alternance des temps du passé, lien cause / conséquence, réflexion personnelle.

criteria: L'élève emploie past simple et past continuous de façon pertinente
L'élève exprime au moins une conséquence
L'élève répond à une question sur son récit

common_errors: Past continuous pour une action brève
Absence de lien logique entre les événements
